description: This file is a server-side script for a SvelteKit application, specifically handling data loading and actions for the contacts list page. It interacts with Django REST API endpoints to fetch, create, update, and delete contact records, transforming data between frontend and backend formats.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads contacts data from API, supports filtering, pagination, and data transformation for frontend display.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new contact via API, processing form data and submitting to backend.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating existing contact details via API, processing form data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of contacts via API based on provided contact ID.

calls: apiRequest('/contacts/', { method: 'POST', body: contactData }, { cookies, org: locals.org })
apiRequest(`/contacts/${contactId}/`, { method: 'PATCH', body: contactData }, { cookies, org: locals.org })
